title: Better Green Apple
description: Nobody likes the red apples! instead, make them green!
body:
![icon](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/09824ad777accddbce4ee874dc1beb8511d93920.png)
Those Red Apples ARE NOT juicy enough for me, So i made them GREEN!

this resource pack will probably not receive updates (except for when minecraft updates)

also i know there are a ton of green apple resource packs out there, but they are terrible, so i made my own

Important notice: the resource pack works on almost all versions. if you got "this resource pack is made for an older/Newer version" its normal, the resource pack will still work (untested on all versions though)
